description: Submit the user's answer to the questions a waiting run asked (needs_input in dsh_wait or dsh_status). Ask the user (your own question tool, or a message), your recommendation first if you have one, and submit their answer. Per question: choose (option numbers or labels), text (an answer in words), or skip. It reaches Harness once every question has an answer (submitted: true; remaining lists the rest); then wait again. If the user already answered in Harness, it says there is no open question.

answers.description: One entry per question answered now

choose.description: Option numbers (1 = first) or labels; one for a single-choice question

id.description: Question id from question.questions[].id; may be left out when there is one question

run_id.description: Run id that is waiting (needs_input: answer)

session_id.description: Instead of run_id: the session a follow wait (dsh_wait with session_id) reported the question for

name: dsh_answer
